canon_ref.note: Rhir/Blighted Lands, a real continent unconnected to Liscor's story so far (see locations.json note on 'rhir'); day number is a placeholder, not synced to the Liscor calendar.

b2.tom_group_garrisons_blighted_village.summary: Tom, one of about twenty Earther 'Heroes' left from a group of fifty, garrisons a frontier village in the Blighted Lands under King Othius the Fourth, meant to hold the border against Demons.

b2.tom_performs_for_village_children.summary: Tom, with his [Clown] class, performs small conjuring and comedy skills for the village's children, including a regular in the audience, a boy named Wilen.

b2.heroes_morale_collapses.summary: Tension boils over among the summoned Heroes - a dead cell phone, a failed spell to contact other Earthers, one member's breakdown - as the group's morale collapses.

canon_ref.note: Ends on a cliffhanger, continued in 1.01C.

b2.demons_raid_village_wilen_hurt.summary: A Demon raiding party attacks the village at night. Unlike the other Heroes, who flee, Tom stays behind to save children - but fails to save Wilen from a Troll.
